reason: The existing mapping of Article 26 (Delegated Regulation) and Article 11(6) (DORA) provides a defensible and complete regulatory basis. Article 11(6)(a) explicitly requires annual testing of ICT business continuity and response/recovery plans, which directly supports the control objective. Article 26 provides the detailed requirements for the content of these plans, including the development of severe but plausible scenarios, which is also a key part of the control objective.
evidence_excerpt: (a) test the ICT business continuity plans and the ICT response and recovery plans in relation to ICT systems supporting all functions at least yearly, as well as in the event of any substantive changes to ICT systems supporting critical or important functions;
applicability_note: The control is applicable to financial entities under the DORA framework, as specified in the assessment item.
challenge_comment: The mapping is adequate as it combines the specific testing frequency requirement from Article 11(6)(a) with the detailed scenario planning requirements from Article 26, which together fully support the control objective.
